description: A collection of utility functions for handling byte data using Uint8Array, with platform-specific implementations for Node.js and web environments.

methods.name: toLocalBufferType
methods.description: Transforms input to an instance of Buffer if running on node, otherwise Uint8Array

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Creates empty space of specified size

methods.name: allocateUnsafe
methods.description: Creates empty space of specified size, using pooled memory when available

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Uint8Arrays are deep equal

methods.name: fromNumberArray
methods.description: Creates a Uint8Array from a number array

methods.name: fromBase64
methods.description: Creates a Uint8Array from a base64 string

methods.name: toBase64
methods.description: Creates a base64 string from bytes

methods.name: fromISO88591
methods.description: Creates a Uint8Array from a legacy ISO8859-1 encoded string

methods.name: toISO88591
methods.description: Converts Uint8Array to a legacy ISO8859-1 string

methods.name: fromHex
methods.description: Creates a Uint8Array from a hex string

methods.name: toHex
methods.description: Creates a lowercase hex string from bytes

methods.name: toUTF8
methods.description: Creates a string from utf8 code units, with error handling for invalid bytes

methods.name: utf8ByteLength
methods.description: Calculates the UTF-8 byte length of a string

methods.name: encodeUTF8Into
methods.description: Encodes UTF8 bytes from a string into a destination Uint8Array, returning the number of bytes written

methods.name: randomBytes
methods.description: Generates a Uint8Array filled with random bytes

methods.name: swap32
methods.description: Swaps byte order of a buffer interpreted as 32-bit values

ctags.name: Buffer
ctags.pattern: /^declare const Buffer: { new (): unknown; prototype?: { _isBuffer?: boolean } } | undefined;$/

ctags.name: ByteUtils
ctags.pattern: /^export const ByteUtils: ByteUtils = hasGlobalBuffer ? nodeJsByteUtils : webByteUtils;$/

ctags.name: nodeJsByteUtils
ctags.pattern: /^export const ByteUtils: ByteUtils = hasGlobalBuffer ? nodeJsByteUtils : webByteUtils;$/

ctags.name: prototype
ctags.pattern: /^declare const Buffer: { new (): unknown; prototype?: { _isBuffer?: boolean } } | undefined;$/
